documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers held its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting the commencement of full-scale commercial production at its Vadodara facility. Management reported strong financial performance for the quarter and full year, driven by operating leverage, cost control, and the transition toward in-house manufacturing. The company outlined its strategic focus on scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the revenue contribution from manufacturing, and expanding binder sales into non-textile industries. Furthermore, management discussed demand dynamics, raw material cost volatility, inventory strategies, and plans to fund future minor equipment additions through internal accruals. Silkflex Polymers reported its financial performance for the fourth quarter and full year of fiscal 2026, highlighting growth in revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to increase by 2% to 3% overall as manufacturing capacity utilization reaches full capacity.
guidance.quote: So overall EBITDA can increase by 200-300 basis points. If seen overall, we can expect expansion by 2% to 3%.

guidance.claim: The company targets 100% capacity utilization of its Vadodara manufacturing facility by the end of financial year 2027.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: Management expects full capacity of 500 tons per month to be achieved by the next financial year.
guidance.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

guidance.claim: The company expects manufacturing EBITDA margins to increase to near about 50% according to production.
guidance.quote: Currently our margin in manufacturing is around 25%. And in the coming time, we can expect margins to be near about 50% according to the production.

guidance.claim: Management expects trading and manufacturing to be equal within 1 and 2 years.
guidance.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates turnover of around INR 70 crores to INR 80 crores from manufacturing at full utilization of the 500-ton capacity.
guidance.quote: It will come to around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.

guidance.claim: Management maintains its revenue expectation to close around INR 110 crores for the year.
guidance.quote: No, of course the same. These two months, January and February, have also gone well for us.

guidance.claim: The company expects growth of 15% to 20% in the textile market and 20% to 30% in the wood coating market.
guidance.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment remains somewhat cautious due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that they expect to selectively expand market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic wood coating segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The paints and coating market, particularly water-based and specialty formulations, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, the paints and coating market, particularly water-based and speciality formulations, align with our core segments, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services as well as regulatory preferences.

demand_outlook.claim: The India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal open significant growth opportunities for Indian textile and furniture exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Thirdly, the recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal opens a significant growth opportunities for Indian textile exports as well as furniture exports by eliminating duties on most of the products, narrowing the competitive gap with countries like Bangladesh and Pakistan.

demand_outlook.claim: India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing as Bangladesh faces challenges.
demand_outlook.quote: The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.

demand_outlook.claim: Both the textile and wood coating segments are growing exceptionally.
demand_outlook.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months funded through internal resources.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Future capacity expansion through additional vessels would cost around 3 to 5 crore rupees.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: Commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking the company’s strategic shift from trading to a manufacturing-led model to enhance margins, scalability, and operational control.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production commenced at the first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, spread over 10 acres with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat. Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The facility features a boiler-less, eco-efficient manufacturing process representing major backward integration.
capex_expansion.quote: The facility features a boiler-less, eco-efficient manufacturing process combined with advanced automation and process controls, which ensuring consistent product quality and high throughput and zero carbon footprint. It not only enhances our production capabilities, but also reflects our strong commitment to sustainability. This development represents a major backward integration for Silkflex.

capex_expansion.claim: Utility, cooling plant, and monomer storage capacity have been installed according to expansion capacity so no more capex is required for further expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, Ryan. We already set up our factory in a major factors like, you can say utility, cooling plant, monomer storage capacity, already we have been instaledl according to the expansion capacity for the further expansion. So we need not require for more capex.

capex_expansion.claim: The manufacturing facility was funded through a bank loan of INR 30 crores, land purchase of INR 10 crores via IPO, and the rest from internal accruals and unsecured promoter loans.
capex_expansion.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

capex_expansion.claim: The expected payback period for the INR 40 crores investment in the manufacturing plant is around 4 to 5 years.
capex_expansion.quote: You can consider around you may know between 4 to 5 years.

margins_costs.claim: In-house manufacturing of textile binders and table glue is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material costs saw a sharp increase during the year due to global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.
margins_costs.quote: To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: The company's proactive inventory strategy helped secure raw materials at favourable blended costs to provide near-term margin stability.
margins_costs.quote: However, our proactive inventory strategy has helped us secure raw materials at favourable blended costs, which should provide margin stability over the near term.

margins_costs.claim: Manufacturing segment EBITDA margins are around 20% to 25%, while the trading business is at 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: we can see that the EBITDA margins are around 20%-25% for the manufacturing segment, and for our trading business it is 12% to 15%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin for Q4 FY26 was reported at 33.2%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Profit Margin (%) 33.2% 39.0% -580 bps 25.0% 820 bps 28.2% 25.8% 240 bps

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q4 FY26 stood at 23.1%.
PAT margin for Q4 FY26 was 11.9%.
Q3 FY26 EBITDA increased by 130.78% year-on-year to INR 7.11 crores due to better operating leverage and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: The profitability improved significantly during the quarter with the EBITDA increasing by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores. Mainly due to better operating leverage and cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Q3 FY26 EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points year-on-year to 21.2%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: The company has not seen significant changes in basic raw material prices in the last 2 years.
margins_costs.quote: In the last 2 years, we haven't seen any significant changes. So, we don't expect too many changes in price movements.

orders_capacity.claim: The Vadodara plant has an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization stood at approximately 60% in the first year of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: The newly commissioned manufacturing facility has an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization in the first 2 months (November and December) of manufacturing was around 60%.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of Q3 revenue, 25% came from manufacturing and 75% from the trading business.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, out of this INR33 crores revenue in Q3, from the manufacturing we are getting 25% and rest of the 75% from the trading business.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that working capital will not become a constraint due to internal availability and good cash flow.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are very confident working capital will not become a constraint at least in the near future.

capital_allocation.claim: The long-term loan for the manufacturing plant is INR 30 crores with a tenure of 7 years and a moratorium period ending June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Our term loan is INR30 crores and working capital is INR20 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital requirements will be funded through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: It of course internal accruals. As huge capex is not required. So there is no need to go for the huge capex.

capital_allocation.claim: The net worth of the company stood at around INR 42 crores by December end.
capital_allocation.quote: So by December end our net worth stood at around INR42 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The interest rate applicable on the company's short-term borrowings is 8.5%.

risks_headwinds.claim: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to import costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to increase the manufacturing contribution toward 50% of the revenue mix.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead to FY2027, our priorities remain clear: scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of our revenue mix, expanding binder sales into non-textile industries as well and deepening our engagement with global brands.

management_commitments.claim: The company envisions establishing Silkflex as a fully integrated, solvent-free, zero-discharge manufacturing company by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, our vision is to establish Silkflex as a fully integrated, solvent-free, zero-discharge manufacturing company among the most advanced and sustainable players in India's textile and coating solution space.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to launch new products resulting from R&D trials within a couple of months.
management_commitments.quote: So, hopefully we will be coming soon within couple of months, we will intimate to you once again when we will get through.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated plans to target increased sales volume through product portfolio expansion and participation in key industry exhibitions and technical seminars.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting increased sales volume through product portfolio expansion and participation in key industry exhibitions (GMMSA, Knit Show) and technical seminars.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated plans to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we plan to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.

management_commitments.claim: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to achieve full capacity utilization by the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects manufacturing and trading to be equal within 1 and 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.
